title: Bun check executor
description: Type check a TypeScript project with `bun check`.

files.description: Files or directories to check (with everything they import). Defaults to the whole project.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the project root.

project.description: Path to a tsconfig.json or its directory (`--project`).

pretty.description: Show source code around each error (`--pretty` / `--no-pretty`). Defaults to Bun's choice.

all.description: Show every error instead of grouping above 50.

threads.description: Number of threads (default: one per CPU core).

noScript.description: Run the type checker even if the project has a `check` script.

args.description: Additional raw flags for `bun check`, e.g. compiler options.
